Zones  == {"z1", "z2"}
Slots  == {"s1", "s2", "s3", "s4"}
NONE   == "none"

ZoneOf == [s1 |-> "z1", s2 |-> "z1", s3 |-> "z2", s4 |-> "z2"]

VARIABLES coarse, fine, phase, cur, inbox

vars == <<coarse, fine, phase, cur, inbox>>

Phases == {"idle", "seeking", "coarse", "fine"}

Init ==
    /\ coarse = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ fine   = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ phase  = "idle"
    /\ cur    = [crane |-> NONE, zone |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox  = {}

Begin(c, s) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ cur'   = [crane |-> c, zone |-> ZoneOf[s], slot |-> s]
    /\ phase' = "seeking"
    /\ inbox' = {[crane |-> c, zone |-> ZoneOf[s]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Grant(m) ==
    /\ phase = "seeking"
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ coarse[m.zone] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![cur.zone] = cur.crane]
    /\ phase'  = "coarse"
    /\ inbox'  = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, cur>>

Alloc ==
    /\ phase = "coarse"
    /\ coarse[cur.zone] = cur.crane
    /\ fine[cur.slot] = NONE
    /\ fine'  = [fine EXCEPT ![cur.slot] = cur.crane]
    /\ phase' = "fine"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, cur, inbox>>

Release ==
    /\ phase = "fine"
    /\ fine'   = [fine EXCEPT ![cur.slot] = NONE]
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![cur.zone] = NONE]
    /\ phase'  = "idle"
    /\ cur'    = [crane |-> NONE, zone |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED inbox

AbortSeek ==
    /\ phase = "seeking"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ inbox' = {}
    /\ cur'   = [crane |-> NONE, zone |-> NONE, slot |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Begin(c, s)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Grant(m)
    \/ Alloc
    \/ Release
    \/ AbortSeek

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in [Zones -> Cranes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ fine   \in [Slots -> Cranes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ phase  \in Phases
    /\ cur \in [crane : Cranes \cup {NONE}, zone : Zones \cup {NONE}, slot : Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ inbox  \subseteq [crane : Cranes, zone : Zones]

    (phase = "coarse") => (fine[cur.slot] = NONE)

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A container-ship crane yard hands out stowage slots using two levels of locking.
Each crane must first take the coarse lock on a whole bay-zone before it may
allocate any of the fine-grained slots inside that zone. A crane begins idle,
posts a request to seize a zone, and that request lands in an unordered radio
inbox where messages may be picked up and processed in any order. When the
grant action fires it takes the coarse lock only if the zone is currently free.
Holding the coarse lock, the crane may allocate an individual free slot in that
zone to itself. The crane may release a fine slot it owns, and it may release
the coarse lock on a zone only once it no longer owns any fine slot in that
zone, returning to idle. Because two cranes can never hold the same zone's
coarse lock at once, and a slot can only be allocated by the crane that holds
its zone, the same slot is never handed to two different cranes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every allocated slot is owned by the crane that currently holds the coarse lock of that slot's zone, so no slot is double-allocated.

    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, wants, crashed>>

NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutEx
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler grants exclusive use of the single sterile
theatre by circulating one token around a ring of surgical teams. Only the team
currently holding the token may enter the theatre, and a team must leave before
the token can move on. A team that wants the theatre first raises a request;
when it holds the token and has an outstanding request it enters, and later it
leaves. The token is passed hand to hand around the ring to the next team. Any
team may crash silently at any moment while it is not inside the theatre; a
crashed team is skipped but, if it happened to hold the token, it may still pass
the token onward so the ring is not deadlocked. Because there is exactly one
token and only its holder may be inside the theatre, two teams can never be
operating in the theatre at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a team is inside the theatre it is the team that currently holds the token, so at most one team occupies the theatre.

NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker fills a single shared arena that seats at
most three players. Two independent matchmaker instances feed the same arena,
and to keep them from over-filling it they pass one admit-token back and forth:
only the instance currently holding the token may seat a waiting player. A join
request from a player is queued as pending on an instance. The token-holding
instance may admit one pending player, which occupies a seat only while the
arena still has room. A seated player may later leave, freeing a seat. The
admit-token is handed between the two instances at any time. Because a seat is
taken only when the arena is below capacity, the number of occupied seats never
climbs above the arena's fixed capacity of three.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of occupied arena seats is never greater than the fixed capacity of three.

---- MODULE W4Od11m7p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
Slots   == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE    == "none"
MAXV    == 3

VARIABLES reg, owner, inbox, winner, lastSlot

vars == <<reg, owner, inbox, winner, lastSlot>>

Init ==
    /\ reg      = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ owner    = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ inbox    = {}
    /\ winner   = NONE
    /\ lastSlot = NONE

Submit(w, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.worker = w /\ m.slot = s
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[worker |-> w, slot |-> s, exp |-> reg[s]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, owner, winner, lastSlot>>

Succeed(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ owner[m.slot] = NONE
    /\ reg[m.slot] = m.exp
    /\ reg[m.slot] < MAXV
    /\ owner'    = [owner EXCEPT ![m.slot] = m.worker]
    /\ reg'      = [reg EXCEPT ![m.slot] = reg[m.slot] + 1]
    /\ winner'   = m.worker
    /\ lastSlot' = m.slot
    /\ inbox'    = inbox \ {m}

Drop(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, owner, winner, lastSlot>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # NONE
    /\ owner'    = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ winner'   = IF s = lastSlot THEN NONE ELSE winner
    /\ lastSlot' = IF s = lastSlot THEN NONE ELSE lastSlot
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, inbox>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, s \in Slots : Submit(w, s)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Succeed(m)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Drop(m)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

    /\ reg      \in [Slots -> 0..MAXV]
    /\ owner    \in [Slots -> Workers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ inbox    \subseteq [worker : Workers, slot : Slots, exp : 0..MAXV]
    /\ winner   \in Workers \cup {NONE}
    /\ lastSlot \in Slots \cup {NONE}

    winner # NONE => owner[lastSlot] = winner

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A print shop job spooler assigns each press slot to exactly one worker using a
compare-and-swap version register per slot. A worker that sees a free slot
submits a claim carrying the register version it observed; claims travel over an
unordered fabric and pile up in a set, so they may be resolved in any order. A
claim succeeds only if the slot is still free and its carried version still
matches the slot's register, at which point the slot's owner is set to that
worker and the register is bumped so any older in-flight claim for that slot can
no longer win. Because the fabric is unordered and lossy, any pending claim may
simply be dropped. A worker may later release a slot it owns, freeing it again.
The spooler records the most recent successful claim as the current winner and
the slot it won. Because a claim only wins on a free slot and immediately takes
ownership, the recorded winner always genuinely owns the slot it was granted, so
the same slot is never allocated to two workers.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a current winner is recorded, that worker is the actual owner of the slot it most recently won.

---- MODULE W4Od16m3p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Slots == {"rx1", "rx2"}
NONE  == "none"
MAXE  == 4

VARIABLES epoch, leader, up, dispensed, phase, serving

vars == <<epoch, leader, up, dispensed, phase, serving>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch     = 0
    /\ leader    = NONE
    /\ up        = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ dispensed = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ phase     = "idle"
    /\ serving   = NONE

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up[n]
    /\ epoch < MAXE
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ epoch'  = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, dispensed, phase, serving>>

FailLeader ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ up'      = [up EXCEPT ![leader] = FALSE]
    /\ leader'  = NONE
    /\ phase'   = "idle"
    /\ serving' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, dispensed>>

Begin(s) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ dispensed[s] = NONE
    /\ serving' = s
    /\ phase'   = "dispensing"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, up, dispensed>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "dispensing"
    /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![serving] = leader]
    /\ phase'     = "idle"
    /\ serving'   = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, up>>

AdminOverride(s, n) ==
    /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![s] = n]
    /\ phase'     = "idle"
    /\ serving'   = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, up>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ FailLeader
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Begin(s)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E s \in Slots, n \in Nodes : AdminOverride(s, n)

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch     \in 0..MAXE
    /\ leader    \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ up        \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ dispensed \in [Slots -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ phase     \in {"idle", "dispensing"}
    /\ serving   \in Slots \cup {NONE}

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    (phase = "dispensing") => (dispensed[serving] = NONE)

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser assigns each prescription slot to exactly one
dispensing node. The nodes run a leader election with failover: while there is
no leader, any node that is up may be elected leader, which advances the epoch
counter. The current leader may fail over at any time, which marks it down and
leaves the post vacant for a fresh election. Only the leader dispenses: it
begins serving a still-unfilled slot, and then commits, recording that the slot
was filled by the leader. A privileged pharmacy administrator may override the
system, force-assigning any slot to any node; an override also cancels any
dispense that was in progress. Because the leader only begins serving a slot
that is currently unfilled and commits to that same slot, and an override always
clears any in-progress serve, no slot is ever committed while already filled.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a dispense is in progress, the slot being served is currently unfilled, so no slot is dispensed twice.

INVARIANT MutEx
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler shares its single theatre between two
independent surgical departments, each of which circulates its own token among
its own teams. A team first raises a request for the theatre. Within each
department the token is passed from team to team around that department's ring,
but never while a team holding it is inside the theatre. Because the theatre is
shared, a team may enter only when it has an outstanding request, holds its own
department's token, and the shared theatre gate is free; entering seizes the
gate and puts the team inside. A team inside later leaves, which empties the
gate and clears its request. Since the single shared gate is held by whoever is
inside and no one can enter while it is held, teams from the two departments can
never be inside the theatre at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every team currently inside the theatre is the holder of the shared gate, so at most one team occupies the theatre.

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Devices == {"d1", "d2"}
NONE == "none"
MAXG == 3
TTL  == 2

VARIABLES gen, holder, ttl, inbox, opened, openGen

vars == <<gen, holder, ttl, inbox, opened, openGen>>

    /\ holder  = NONE
    /\ ttl     = 0
    /\ inbox   = {}
    /\ opened  = NONE
    /\ openGen = 0

Grant(d) ==
    /\ opened = NONE
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ gen < MAXG
    /\ gen'    = gen + 1
    /\ holder' = d
    /\ ttl'    = TTL
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, opened, openGen>>

Tick ==
    /\ ttl > 0
    /\ ttl' = ttl - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, holder, inbox, opened, openGen>>

Expire ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ ttl = 0
    /\ opened = NONE
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, ttl, inbox, opened, openGen>>

SendCmd(d) ==
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.dev = d /\ m.gen = gen
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[dev |-> d, gen |-> gen]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, holder, ttl, opened, openGen>>

Act(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ opened = NONE
    /\ m.dev = holder
    /\ m.gen = gen
    /\ ttl > 0
    /\ opened'  = m.dev
    /\ openGen' = gen
    /\ inbox'   = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, holder, ttl>>

Close ==
    /\ opened # NONE
    /\ opened' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, holder, ttl, inbox, openGen>>

Drop(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, holder, ttl, opened, openGen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Devices : Grant(d)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Expire
    \/ \E d \in Devices : SendCmd(d)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Act(m)
    \/ Close
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Drop(m)

    /\ gen     \in 0..MAXG
    /\ holder  \in Devices \cup {NONE}
    /\ ttl     \in 0..TTL
    /\ inbox   \subseteq [dev : Devices, gen : 0..MAXG]
    /\ opened  \in Devices \cup {NONE}
    /\ openGen \in 0..MAXG

    (opened # NONE) => (opened = holder /\ openGen = gen)

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Authorized
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network grants a device the right to open the door only
by handing it a time-limited lease. When the post is vacant a device may be
granted the lease, which advances the lease generation and starts a fresh
countdown. Time passes in ticks that draw the countdown down, and once it
reaches zero the lease may expire, vacating the post. A device issues unlock
commands stamped with the lease generation it believes is current; commands
travel over an unordered radio fabric, accumulate in a set, and may be delivered
in any order, and because that fabric is lossy any pending command may simply be
dropped. The door is actually opened only when a command's device is the current
lease holder, its stamped generation equals the current generation, and the
lease has not run out; opening records who opened it and under which generation.
The door is later closed. Because a lease cannot be rotated or expired while the
door is open, an opened door always reflects the current holder and generation.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the door is open, it was opened by the current lease holder under the current lease generation, so no stale or unauthorized device ever opens it.

NONE == "none"
CAP == 2

WingOf == [o1 |-> "g1", o2 |-> "g1", o3 |-> "g2", o4 |-> "g2"]

VARIABLES coarse, fine, occ, crashed

vars == <<coarse, fine, occ, crashed>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse  = [w \in Wings |-> NONE]
    /\ fine    = [r \in Rooms |-> NONE]
    /\ occ     = {}
    /\ crashed = [t \in Teams |-> FALSE]

GrabCoarse(t, w) ==
    /\ ~ crashed[t]
    /\ coarse[w] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![w] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, occ, crashed>>

GrabFine(t, r) ==
    /\ ~ crashed[t]
    /\ coarse[WingOf[r]] = t
    /\ fine[r] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![r] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, occ, crashed>>

Occupy(t, r) ==
    /\ ~ crashed[t]
    /\ fine[r] = t
    /\ coarse[WingOf[r]] = t
    /\ r \notin occ
    /\ Cardinality(occ) < CAP
    /\ occ' = occ \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, crashed>>

Vacate(r) ==
    /\ r \in occ
    /\ occ'    = occ \ {r}
    /\ fine'   = [fine EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![WingOf[r]] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Release(t, r) ==
    /\ fine[r] = t
    /\ r \notin occ
    /\ fine'   = [fine EXCEPT ![r] = NONE]
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![WingOf[r]] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occ, crashed>>

Crash(t) ==
    /\ ~ crashed[t]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, occ>>

Recover(t) ==
    /\ crashed[t]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, occ>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Teams, w \in Wings : GrabCoarse(t, w)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : GrabFine(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Occupy(t, r)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Vacate(r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Release(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Crash(t)
    \/ \E t \in Teams : Recover(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse  \in [Wings -> Teams \cup {NONE}]
    /\ fine    \in [Rooms -> Teams \cup {NONE}]
    /\ occ     \subseteq Rooms
    /\ crashed \in [Teams -> BOOLEAN]

WithinCapacity ==
    Cardinality(occ) <= CAP

====

nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler limits how many surgeries run at once by
capping concurrent theatre occupancy at two, using nested locks to coordinate.
A team must first grab the coarse lock on a surgical wing, then grab the fine
lock on a specific room in that wing. Holding both locks it may occupy the room,
but only while fewer than two rooms are currently occupied, which enforces the
capacity cap. A team vacates an occupied room, freeing the room's fine lock and
the wing's coarse lock. A team that grabbed locks but never occupied may instead
release them, abandoning the attempt and freeing both locks. Any team may crash
silently at any time, after which it can no longer grab locks or occupy rooms; a
crashed team may later recover. Because a room is occupied only while the number
of occupied rooms is still below the cap, the number of simultaneously occupied
rooms never exceeds two.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of simultaneously occupied operating rooms never exceeds the capacity cap of two.
